text:
Jenna (CSM): Heads up — EdgeWorks (renewal in 6w) just moved to red. Usage down ~68% over last 30d and procurement just looped in a new infra lead who is running a competing pilot. Need quick triage.
Omar (AM): can you paste the usage slice and any recent error spikes?
Jenna (CSM): quick snapshot from telemetry: 
```
30d tokens/day: 12k -> 3.9k -> 1.2k (last 7d)
Active seats: 18 -> 12
Top endpoints: /embeddings (60%), /chat (25%), rerank (15%)
Recent errors: none across prod routes; latency steady
```
Mike (Sales): hmm — new infra lead usually means cost/architecture questions. Have they asked for pricing comparison?
Jenna (CSM): Alyssa said procurement asked for a cost/throughput comparison vs. Vectorium (competitor). Alyssa also flagged a budget freeze request from finance.
Tara (Eng): if they're evaluating Vectorium they're probably focused on embeddings throughput and on-prem options. We can run a 3-day dedicated pilot on a 4xA10 cluster to show throughput; need legal ok for pilot terms.
Mike (Sales): propose we offer a 2-week pilot + an Optimize audit (free) to demonstrate caching/batching savings. Omar / Jenna — can we get buy-in for a discounted pilot?
Omar (AM): I can propose pilot discount if CSM confirms engagement plan and an exec sponsorship. Jenna — can you confirm who's the new infra lead and if they'd accept a short technical readout?
Jenna (CSM): Infra lead is "Marco (EdgeWorks)" — cc'ed below. He asked for a perf matrix (cost per 1M embeddings, avg latency at 16k tokens, failure rate).
Alyssa (EdgeWorks): confirming: Marco wants a perf run and a written delta vs Vectorium on cost/latency. Also priority is an on-prem trial or VPC because of data residency. Finance temporarily paused new annual commitments while the pilot runs.
Tara (Eng): we can produce the perf matrix. Quick ask: do they need HSM/KMS integration in pilot? if yes that changes timeline.
Jenna (CSM): not yet, Alyssa said KMS is optional for pilot but required for deployment.
ops-bot: note created — renewal_watch:edgeworks:1703456789, assigned: @Jenna
Mike (Sales): next steps I suggest: 1) offer 2-week dedicated pilot (discounted) 2) provide perf matrix + comparative doc vs Vectorium 3) schedule a 30-min tech readout with Tara + Marco 4) run a small embedding cache demo to show unit-cost improvement.
Omar (AM): I'll draft pilot commercial terms and loop Legal. Jenna — can you own scheduling and collect the exact perf targets Marco wants?
Jenna (CSM): will do. I'll set a meeting with Marco and Alyssa for tomorrow. Also putting together a short one-pager for Finance that highlights SLOs and expected unit-cost with caching.
Alyssa (EdgeWorks): appreciated. If you can show a 3–4x reduction in per-embedding cost with caching and quantization, we'll fast-track the pilot approval.
Tara (Eng): noted. I'll prepare a short playbook: required infra, expected throughput, sample commands to reproduce perf.
Mike (Sales): tagging @legal for pilot terms draft and @pm for any roadmap asks.
Jenna (CSM): thanks all — I'll post the meeting invite + the perf request form here after I speak with Marco. :thumbsup:
Omar (AM): thanks — marking as high priority.
ops-bot: reminder set for 72h follow-up on pilot readiness (automated).
